summary: This note is the header file component_parser.hpp from the ros2_control hardware_interface package, copyright 2020 ros2_control Development Team and licensed under Apache License 2.0. It declares a single function, parse_control_resources_from_urdf, which takes a URDF string and returns a vector of HardwareInfo describing the robot's control resources. The function throws std::runtime_error if a required robot attribute or tag is missing.
